original_rationale:
Complete H.R.275EH requires a public DHSwebpage and named-committee monthly report by the seventh day of each month starting with the first full post-enactment month. It covers preceding-month encounter totals/nationality or last habitual residence, regional and land/air/sea/interior breakdowns and covered-nation identification; first report additionally coversJanuary20,2021-January19,2025. The printed special-interest definition is potential risk based on travel-pattern analysis, not actual terrorism or wrongdoing by a person. The dated named definitions are linked below; general reporting/public-webpage versus direct technology-governance, current-law integration and committee-substitute/adopted-version binding remain ordinary research, consistent with the unresolved reporting taxonomy boundary. No new data-system construction or actual threat/encounter count inferred.

Dated named-definition context only: the complete retained 2024 section1101(a)(3) unit defines alien as a person who is NEITHER a United States citizen NOR a United States national. It is not synonymous with every noncitizen; US nationals are excluded. H.R.275 prints its section101/8USC1101 reference broadly; this context does not rewrite that citation or import other1101definitions. The separate complete retained2024section4872(f)(2)unit lists exactly FOUR covered nations: Democratic People's Republic of North Korea, People's Republic of China, Russian Federation, and Islamic Republic of Iran. Only this named list is incorporated here, not surrounding defense-procurement restrictions, powers or all4872provisions. Dated list membership is NOT an individual risk finding, nationality-based security inference or a current list certification. The own bill's special-interest category separately requires travel-pattern analysis of POTENTIAL risk; being from a covered nation alone does not satisfy it. The reporting duty conditionally identifies covered nationalities/countries of last habitual residence among those reported encounters, without proving any actual encounter, wrongdoing or terrorism. These86and209character units do not certify complete1101/4872, present law, adopted-version equivalence, any actual person's citizenship/nationality/risk or a new data-system construction duty. Existing pending interpretation and unresolved version binding remain; whole reporting-versus-Infrastructure membership and current-law/version integration are not accepted.
